title: Reproducing History Is Not Enough: Intervention-Level Assurance for LLM-Generated Simulators
abstract: arXiv:2611.31736v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models can now write simulation programs of operational processes and workflows. These programs can be reused to answer what-if questions on new records and policies. However, a program that reproduces recorded history can still give wrong answers to what-if questions; requested changes may be applied wrongly, or they may be applied to records other than the ones the question is about, or the program may stop being valid once its policy is revised. Current checks return a pass-or-fail verdict for the whole program, which says little about whether any single answer can be trusted. We propose Vouch, a library that judges whether an answer from a generated simulator can be trusted for the change being asked about. Each what-if question is turned into a structured change, which is checked against the program and the current records. translated_title: 重现历史是不够的：针对LLM生成模拟器的干预级保障
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型现在已经能够编写用于模拟操作流程和工作流的仿真程序。这些程序可以被复用来针对新记录和新政策回答“假如（what-if）”问题。然而，一个能够重现已记录历史的程序，在回答“假如”问题时仍可能给出错误答案：所请求的更改可能被错误地应用，或者被应用到与问题无关的记录上，或者一旦其政策被修改，程序就可能失效。现有的检查方法只对整个程序给出通过或不通过的判定，这几乎无法说明任何单个答案是否可信。我们提出了Vouch，一个用于判断生成的模拟器所给出的答案对于所询问的更改是否可信的库。每个“假如”问题都被转化为一个结构化的更改，该更改会对照程序和当前记录进行检查。该库还会记录每个程序通过或失败的更改类型，并……
tldr: 该论文提出Vouch库，通过将每个what-if问题转化为结构化更改并对照程序与当前记录进行验证，实现对LLM生成模拟器单次答案可信度的干预级保障，而非仅对整个程序给出通过与否的整体判定。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Vouch, a library that provides intervention-level assurance for LLM-generated simulators by converting each what-if question into a structured change checked against the program and current records, judging whether individual answers can be trusted instead of issuing a pass-or-fail verdict for the whole program.
